ideas.topic: The Makeup Secret of the Pharaohs
ideas.hook: You think eyeliner is modern, but the Egyptians were wearing it to prevent eye infections 5,000 years ago.
ideas.why: It bridges the gap between everyday modern beauty trends and historical utility, following the 'did you know' educational curiosity pattern.

ideas.topic: Why Cats Were Actually Considered Gods
ideas.hook: If you hurt a cat in Ancient Egypt, you could actually face the death penalty.
ideas.why: It leverages the massive popularity of cat-related historical content while grounding it in a surprising, high-stakes legal fact.

ideas.topic: The Mystery of the Missing Nose
ideas.hook: Ever notice how almost every ancient statue is missing its nose? It wasn't just age; it was a deliberate act of political erasure.
ideas.why: It addresses a common visual observation viewers have about the topic, transforming an oddity into a compelling historical mystery.
